title: A Brief History of Quantum Mechanics - with Sean Carroll
summary: Sean Carroll gives a Royal Institution talk tracing the history of quantum mechanics from Einstein and Bohr to today. He covers the Copenhagen interpretation and the many worlds interpretation.
why: Recommended as an approachable entry point to quantum interpretations, and cited on many worlds questions.

quote.text: Sean Carroll is a master of making quantum mechanics approachable to non-physicists.
